name: echo_auc_check
description: When a complete transthoracic echo is ordered, checks for a prior complete TTE within six months, a pending TTE order not yet resulted, and an echo already on the schedule; asks the provider whether the exam is needed with one button that documents the reason in the note. When a duplicate is signed, tasks the other ordering provider that their pending study may be cancellable. Informs, never blocks.

handlers.description: On imaging order update or commit: card for prior, pending, or scheduled complete TTE; on commit, task to the other provider for a signed duplicate.
